creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From chat note SAB3ob2vD0q, 2026-10-26: "auto close groups if all involved panes are read and agents closed." Confirmed with the owner on 2026-10-27: close a message group automatically once all its messages have been read and all participating agent panes have closed.

Finished rounds should not leave groups for the owner to clear manually. Both conditions matter: unread messages still need attention, and a group whose agents are still present may have more work to do.

Open design choices: whether closing leaves or hides the group for the human, archives its conversation, or deletes the group; what history remains available; and what happens if an agent later resumes. The existing group-delete command is manual.
title: Read message groups close automatically after their agent panes close
